home.problemHeading: The Foundational Learning Challenge in Middle School
home.problemText: According to official national data from UDISE+ (2024-25) and ASER (2024), foundational arithmetic and reading gaps accumulated in early grades become acute barriers when students encounter abstract concepts in Classes 6 through 10. Without individualized diagnostic support, classroom instruction moves forward while learning gaps compound.
home.frameworkDesc: Built from the ground up on CBSE/NCERT curriculum standards for Mathematics, Science, English, and Social Science across grades 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10.

howItWorks.title: How BodhAI Works
howItWorks.subtitle: An evidence-based adaptive cycle engineered to diagnose prerequisites, bridge learning gaps, and build enduring conceptual mastery.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Micro-assessments determine prerequisite gaps from earlier grades rather than simply measuring test score outcomes.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Targeted bilingual visual explanations illustrate core concepts in simple, accessible language with relatable Indian examples.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Scaffolded practice problems adjust difficulty dynamically using Bayesian knowledge tracing algorithms.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Low-stakes mastery checks confirm retention without inducing performance anxiety or exam fatigue.
howItWorks.step5Desc: The learning path re-calibrates in real time, serving remedial refreshers or accelerated challenges based on individual student mastery.

students.title: Built for Student Autonomy
students.subtitle: Learn at your own pace without fear of making mistakes.
students.card1Desc: Struggling with linear equations? BodhAI identifies if fraction arithmetic or variable fundamentals from Class 6 need a quick 5-minute refresher first.
students.card2Desc: Switch freely between Hindi and English anytime you need clarity on complex technical terminology.
students.card3Desc: Practice in a private, supportive environment designed to reward perseverance, systematic reasoning, and self-correction.

teachers.title: Empowering Classroom Teachers
teachers.subtitle: Actionable diagnostic insights that respect your pedagogy and save valuable instructional time.
teachers.card1Desc: Instantly see which foundational concepts need whole-class remediation before introducing a new chapter.
teachers.card2Desc: Assign targeted problem sets calibrated to distinct competency tiers within the same section.
teachers.card3Desc: Access clear student progress trails linked directly to NCERT learning outcomes.

schools.title: Scalable Infrastructure for Schools
schools.subtitle: Designed for rural and urban school environments with intermittent connectivity.
schools.feature1: Lightweight client bundle compatible with low-cost tablets and smart classrooms
schools.feature2: Offline sync architecture allowing school labs to download packs and sync progress intermittently
schools.feature3: Strict student data protection aligned with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023
schools.feature4: Role-based administrative dashboards for principals and department heads

languagesOffline.title: Vernacular First & Offline Resilient
languagesOffline.subtitle: High-quality education must not depend on high-speed fiber or English-only materials.
languagesOffline.langDesc: All questions, explanations, feedback, and diagnostic prompts are fully authored in both English and Hindi, with planned expansion to additional regional languages.
languagesOffline.offlineDesc: Download chapter problem sets and conceptual guides over 2G/3G connections or school Wi-Fi, practice completely offline, and synchronize progress automatically when connectivity resumes.

privacySafety.title: Student Privacy & Child Safety
privacySafety.subtitle: Engineering guardrails prioritizing minor safety and data minimization.
privacySafety.principle1Desc: We do not collect government identification numbers, biometric markers, or sensitive personal indicators. Only essential learning telemetry is processed.
privacySafety.principle2Desc: BodhAI contains zero commercial advertisements, zero behavioral ad tracking, and zero monetization of student activity.
privacySafety.principle3Desc: Platform architecture adheres to parental consent requirements and student rights under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (2023).

about.subtitle: Dedicated to democratizing high-quality adaptive learning for Indian schools.

legal.draftNoticeBanner: DRAFT VERSION — This document is published for platform preview and transparency purposes. It is currently undergoing formal legal review under Indian statutory law (including the DPDP Act 2023 and IT Act 2000).
legal.privacySubtitle: Last updated: October 2026. Pending formal legal review.
legal.termsSubtitle: Last updated: October 2026. Pending formal legal review.
legal.privacyP1: 1. Scope & Application: This draft privacy policy describes how BodhAI processes learning telemetry for students in Classes 6 through 10 in India. This policy is subject to change following finalized legal counsel review.
legal.privacyP2: 2. Data Collected: We collect minimal account identifiers (email or username) and exercise telemetry (question response timestamps, accuracy, skill mastery scores). We do not collect Aadhaar numbers or financial credentials.
legal.privacyP3: 3. Parental & Guardian Rights: For minors under 18, accounts require institutional school enrollment or verified parental consent in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023.
legal.termsP1: 1. Educational Use Only: BodhAI is provided solely for educational practice, diagnostic assessment, and curricular mastery support. It does not certify official board examination marks.
legal.termsP2: 2. Intellectual Property: Curriculum taxonomies follow NCERT public domain framework structures. All software source code is governed by project licensing.
legal.termsP3: 3. Platform Availability: While we strive for high uptime and offline resilience, the software is provided as a pre-release platform under active development.
